summary: Frontend-only test of the Kiosk Beheer popups, now rebuilt in Facturen style (embedded JSX branches + KioskFx components). Tested at 1920x800 and 390x844, logged in as demo@surirent.sr on /kiosk. All 11 popups (locaties, appartementen, huurders, contracten, betalingen, regelingen, onderhoud, werknemers, notificaties, borg, nfc) show the three <prefix>-fx-stats tiles: rounded-xl, bg-slate-50, tiny uppercase label, bold coloured value. The values make sense: Onderhoud Open 3 / In behandeling 2 / Afgerond 0 matches its tabs, Contracten 5/0/5, Borg 5 / SRD 30.000 / 0, Betalingen follows the selected month. The tab bars are full width, h-10, active tab orange, and show counts on every page except regelingen. Every tab filters correctly, with row counts matching the labels. All 9 search fields are 44px high with a 12px radius and a single border (the inner input has no border, background or shadow); 'zzz' gives 0 rows and clearing restores the list. Rows are rounded-xl, 1px slate-200 border, white, title/sub/meta on the left, amount and uppercase status on the right, chevron when clickable. Detail pages with an orange Terug link and a grey header card open and return correctly for loc, apt, tenant, plan, payment and deposit. The 'Markeer betaald' button (plan-pay-*) is white text on #FF5C00, now visible. Row actions: tenant-pin opens the PIN modal; tenant-poster opens a new tab; tenant-delete shows its own modal and cancel keeps all 5 rows; contract-pdf opens a new tab; contract-email opens the send dialog (send-cancel closes it); contract-delete cancel keeps 5 rows; contract-link copy shows an alert 'Kopieren mislukt', expected because headless has no clipboard; maint start→done→reopen works with live stat updates and was restored to its original state; maint/emp delete cancel works; emp-ai-toggle on/off works and was restored; emp-pin and emp-edit open their forms. Betalingen month prev/next works (Okt→Sep→Okt, rows and stats update; next is disabled on the current month). Every 'Nieuw …' footer button opens the right create form; all were cancelled, no data created. Sluiten closes each popup. Facturen (reference) works and the new pages match it visually. NFC popup: stats update to the chosen tenant, search works, save stays disabled without a uid, footer close works. Mobile: popups are full-screen, 3 tiles in one row, the huurders tabs scroll sideways, no page overflow (scrollWidth 390). Regression: /admin/tenants and /admin/payments still use the old non-kiosk layout (no .kiosk-fx, no fx-stats).

design_issues.screen: Mobile 390px - Contracten, Huurders, Werknemers, Onderhoud lists
issues: Rows with 3-4 inline FxIconBtn actions (w-10 each) leave only ~60-130px for the text, so titles get truncated badly: 'Jan Pie…', 'Anita …', 'Marli…', 'Lekkende kraan …'. Facturen's list rows have no inline actions, so it does not have this problem. Suggestion: on small screens put the actions on a second line inside the row (flex-wrap / sm:flex-row), or hide the amount/status column when actions are present.
The plan-filter tabs (Actief / Voltooid / Geannuleerd / Alles) have no '(count)' labels, unlike all other pages and Facturen (PaymentPlans.jsx line 96-97 passes no count).

Some tile labels/values are cut off with an ellipsis at 390px: 'ACTIEVE HUUR…', 'ZONDER APPAR…', 'TOTAAL OKTOB…', 'SALARIS PER M…', 'HUUR PER MAAND', 'SRD 35.000,00', 'Uitgeschakeld'. Consider shorter labels or a smaller value font on mobile.
Borg (deposit-detail-back) and Betalingen (payment-detail-back) use a ChevronLeft icon, while the other pages and Facturen use ArrowLeft (FxBack). Small visual inconsistency.
'Totaal oktober' shows 'SRD 26.000' with no decimals, while other pages show 'SRD 30.000,00'. Inconsistent money format.

action_items: Mobile: stop the inline row actions from squeezing the titles (contracten, huurders, werknemers, onderhoud): wrap the actions below the text on narrow screens
Add counts to the Betalingsregelingen tabs (plan-filter-*) for consistency
Optional: shorter stat labels on mobile; use FxBack/ArrowLeft in Deposits and Payments detail; use the same money format in the Betalingen total tile
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx is a very large file (>4000 lines); adding more embedded branches makes it worse, so consider extracting TenantsPage/ApartmentsPage
The embedded and non-embedded branches duplicate the filter/search logic in each admin page; shared hooks would reduce drift
FxRow with actions renders a div with role=button and also a nested <button> in the actions; fine functionally, but nested interactive elements inside role=button are an a11y smell

success_rate.frontend: 97% - all functional checks passed; only design/consistency findings

seed_data_creation: None. The maintenance status and the employee AI toggle were changed and then restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: in-page fetch POST /api/auth/login demo@surirent.sr/demo1234, then goto /kiosk. Open with window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kiosk-nav',{detail:'admin:<id>'})); wait on kiosk-popup-<id>-footer-close (NFC: nfc-link-footer-close; Facturen: invoices-modal-close). Tenant delete uses its own tenant-delete-modal/tenant-delete-cancel (not embed-confirm). Contract email dialog closes with send-cancel. The deposit detail back testid is deposit-detail-back (not dep-detail-back).
